answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with randomized liveness audits: each epoch, the network sends a random sample of agents a short-deadline puzzle tied to their private key — like a summit checkpoint that only a live climber can reach in time. Honest agents answer easily, but an attacker running a thousand fake identities must solve a thousand puzzles at once; the shared deadline turns fake numbers into a real cost. Each missed audit emits a public signal that downgrades the identity, the way stale nectar warns bees away, so Sybils rot fast while genuine agents keep working.
